reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Wyoming
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    "Is it specified whether the law requires a tenant to pay a bond in order to appeal an eviction judgment?"
*/

% -------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement encoded)
% -------------------------

scenario_state(wyoming).
focus_year(2021).

scenario_case_type(eviction_judgment).   % eviction judgment / writ of restitution context
scenario_court(circuit_court).

scenario_person(tenant1).
scenario_role(tenant1, defendant).       % tenant is the defendant in the eviction case
scenario_action(tenant1, appeals_eviction_judgment).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement is satisfied.
   It captures the whole scenario in one reusable logical check. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(wyoming),
    focus_year(2021),
    scenario_case_type(eviction_judgment),
    scenario_court(circuit_court),
    scenario_person(Tenant),
    scenario_role(Tenant, defendant),
    scenario_action(Tenant, appeals_eviction_judgment).

% -------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
% -------------------------

/* WY Stat  1-21-1014(b) (2021) - "bond required" for stay on appeal
   Rule: A defendant's appeal does NOT stay proceedings on the judgment unless,
   within 48 hours after judgment (Sundays excepted), the appellant executes and
   files a bond to plaintiff with sufficient sureties, etc.
*/
statute_1_21_1014_bond_required_for_stay_on_appeal(wyoming, 2021, defendant, eviction_judgment).

/* WY Stat  1-21-1015(a) (2021) - rents to be deposited on appeal
   Rule: For appeals from circuit court judgments for rents due/payable,
   in addition to the bond required by W.S. 1-21-1014, appellant must deposit
   rent specified in the judgment; otherwise the appeal is not perfected.
*/
statute_1_21_1015_additional_rent_deposit_required_for_perfecting_appeal(wyoming, 2021, rents_due_judgment) :-
    % Explicitly depends on existence of bond requirement in  1-21-1014.
    statute_1_21_1014_bond_required_for_stay_on_appeal(wyoming, 2021, defendant, eviction_judgment).

/* WY Stat  1-21-1007 (2021) - bond on granting continuance
   Rule: No continuance > 2 days unless defendant gives a bond conditioned for rent and costs, etc.
   (Not directly about appeal; included because provided in statutes.)
*/
statute_1_21_1007_bond_required_for_long_continuance(wyoming, 2021, defendant).

% -------------------------
% Reasoning helpers (apply statutes to scenario)
% -------------------------

/* The law "specifies" a bond requirement in the appeal context for an eviction judgment
   if it states that a bond is required to obtain a stay of proceedings pending appeal. */
law_specifies_bond_requirement_for_appeal_context(State, Year, eviction_judgment) :-
    statute_1_21_1014_bond_required_for_stay_on_appeal(State, Year, defendant, eviction_judgment).

/* More general: law specifies a bond requirement connected to an appeal if either:
   - bond is required for stay on appeal (eviction judgment), or
   - bond (and deposits) are required to perfect an appeal (rents due judgment).
*/
law_specifies_bond_requirement_for_appeal_context(State, Year, CaseType) :-
    CaseType = rents_due_judgment,
    statute_1_21_1015_additional_rent_deposit_required_for_perfecting_appeal(State, Year, CaseType).

/* Connect scenario to the legal question:
   We interpret the question as asking whether Wyoming law explicitly addresses/sets a bond
   requirement tied to taking an appeal from an eviction judgment (at least for staying enforcement). */
scenario_has_specified_bond_requirement_answered(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    scenario_case_type(CaseType),
    law_specifies_bond_requirement_for_appeal_context(State, Year, CaseType),
    !.
scenario_has_specified_bond_requirement_answered(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -------------------------
% Final answer predicate (must be deterministic)
% -------------------------

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_has_specified_bond_requirement_answered(Result),
    !.

% -------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified whether the law requires a tenant to pay a bond in order to appeal an eviction judgment?
